summary: SVG semicircle gauge for a single value on a bounded scale, with an optional target and status bands; exposed as role="meter".
whenToUse: Showing a single value against a known minimum and maximum (usage, score, progress toward a budget).
Highlighting which band (ok, warning, critical) a dashboard indicator falls in.
whenNotToUse: Comparing multiple values: use BarChart or RadialBarChart.
Values without a meaningful maximum: use KpiCard or Statistic.
Trends over time: use LineChart or Sparkline.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value; the arc is clamped to [min, max], the text shows the actual value.

props.name: max
props.description: End of the scale (3 o'clock); if it isn't greater than min, min + 1 is used.

props.name: target
props.description: Target, drawn as a tick on the arc with the "Obiettivo" label.

props.name: bands
props.description: Colored bands of the scale using status colors; each band starts where the previous one ends (the first starts at min).

props.name: label
props.description: Caption below the value in the center; names the meter when there is no title.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of the value, target, minimum, and maximum in the current locale.

props.name: size
props.description: Arc diameter in px (plus margins for the target label); the chart shrinks with its container.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses a gradient and a glow on the value arc; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Not interactive: the meter doesn't receive focus; screen readers read the value during normal navigation.

accessibility: <figure> with <figcaption>; the chart area has role="meter" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext (formatted value and target).
The meter's name is the title (aria-labelledby) or label.
The SVG is aria-hidden: all information is in the meter, so there is no data table.
In forced-colors mode, the value arc uses Highlight, and the track and bands use Canvas with a CanvasText border.
responsive: SVG with viewBox: scales up to size px while preserving its aspect ratio; margins adapt to the target label.
Arc fill animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) paints the arc with a gradient between --dc-color-data-1 and --dc-color-accent-default; it falls back to flat in forced-colors mode.
commonMistakes: Using the gauge for values without a natural maximum: the position on the arc is meaningless.
Relying only on band color for status: also state the threshold in text (label or description).
Placing many gauges side by side to compare values: a RadialBarChart or BarChart is easier to read.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Gradient and glow with the theme colors.

limits: Semicircle only (180°): no 270° arcs and no needle.
Bands are not announced by screen readers: describe the thresholds in text if they matter.
